einzeiler: Celebrating Robert Schumann with his song-cycle Frauenliebe und Leben and Three Romances.
kurzfassung: The episode explores the life and music of Robert Schumann, born in Germany in 1810. It features a performance of his song-cycle Frauenliebe und Leben by Christa River and Judith Gordon. Additionally, the program presents Schumann's Three Romances for Oboe and Piano recorded in 2012.
stichpunkte: Robert Schumann was born in Zwickau, Germany, on June 8, 1810
Schumann initially studied law in Leipzig before transitioning to music
An injury to his hand shifted his musical focus from piano to composition
Schumann married Clara Wieck in 1840 against his father's wishes
Frauenliebe und Leben sets poetry by Adelbert von Chamisso to music
The song-cycle tells a woman's story of love, marriage, and loss
Christa River and Judith Gordon perform the song-cycle in studio
The episode also features Schumann's Three Romances for Oboe and Piano

kapitel.titel: Three Romances for Oboe and Piano

clips.hook: Born in Zwickau, law student turned composer
clips.text: The composer entered the world in a German town in 1810 and initially pursued legal studies before shifting entirely to musical pursuits.

clips.hook: An eight-song story of love and heartbreak
clips.text: A collection of vocal pieces traces a female perspective on romance, from initial encounters through matrimony to eventual grief and separation.

clips.hook: Studio recordings of the Three Romances
clips.text: A later segment of the broadcast highlights instrumental chamber music captured in the station's studio a decade prior.

beschreibung:
Robert Schumann was born in this month in 1810, so we have Krista River and Judith Gordon performing Schumann's great song-cycle, "Frauenliebe und Leben", "A Woman's Love and Life", composed in 1840, the year Schumann married Clara Wieck. Also on the program, Schumann's Three Romances for Oboe and Piano, played by oboist Keisuke Wakao with pianist Christoph Eschenbach.

Robert Schumann: Frauenliebe und Leben, Op.42

Krista River, mezzo-soprano; Judith Gordon, piano

Recorded in a live broadcast at WCRB's Fraser Performance Studio on February 4th, 2008.

Robert Schumann: Three Romances, Op. 94

Keisuke Wakao, oboe; Christoph Eschenbach, piano

Recorded in a live broadcast at WCRB's Fraser Performance Studio, March 1st, 2012
